about: Check errors `make parity` expects after `rw import ork` of OpenRocket examples 1-7 (crates/rw-cli/tests/import_parity.rs). Every other case must check with exit 0. These come from the example models themselves (OpenRocket does not check interference or fit) or from a missing RocketWright model; the import reproduces the file faithfully. The test fails when an error appears that is not listed here, or a listed one no longer occurs (then delete it here).

2.reason: The model's coupler is 24.10 mm wide, sized for the paper body tube, but the printed fin can it also enters has a 23.19 mm bore.
Same coupler: past the fin can's fore end it is inside the paper tube, but inside the fin can it does not fit the bore (reported twice: length outside a fitting bore, and the wall).
The model's motor tube (21.70 mm) runs 5.2 mm into the coupler (21.66 mm bore).
The model places the wadding mass 2.0 mm into the shock cord's packed volume.

7.reason: The model nests a 97.28 mm coupler in a coupler with a 96.88 mm bore.
The model places the nested coupler 0.3 mm into a bulkhead.
Same nested coupler, through its parent's wall.
The model's coupler-end bulkheads are airframe-bore discs (99.06 mm) placed inside the coupler length (96.88 mm bore); the same for the entries below.
